items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Gus Johnson in the context of a band with Gene Ramey and Bird, but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond or provide any personal anecdote or confirmation of a direct relationship with Gus Johnson.

ctx.x: Ramey was playing the bass. I think it was Gus Johnson on drums.
I know Gus was in that band at the time with Gene and Bird.
